capabilities: Display banner images above notes with a note > tag > global priority hierarchy
Assign banners to notes by tag rules with drag-and-drop priority
Override banner style, height, and header per note via frontmatter properties
Overlay titles and icons on banners using templates like {{filename}}
Convert existing banner properties to standard wikilink format
extras: README says the plugin was not yet approved for the community plugin store at time of writing; pre-releases are installable via the BRAT plugin.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a spiritual successor to the original Banners plugin created by noatpad.
motivation: The author rewrote the original Banners concept from scratch in Svelte 5 to get better performance, stability, and easier maintenance.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to show a decorative banner image above the note title.

relations.evidence: a spiritual successor to the original Banners plugin created by noatpad

summary: Banner plugin that displays customizable header images at the top of notes, set globally, by tag rule, or per note via frontmatter overrides.
